Residents:
Ines (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: friends, music, houseplants. Note: Was home sick Friday and Saturday. On Monday, was out 12:00–16:00 (likely errands/walk), returning with personal items.
Yuki (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: meditation, movies, houseplants. Cares for the dog.
Hana (40s, WFH): Weekdays at desk 9:00–17:30, sometimes out for lunch. Weekends sleeps in, midday errands, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, snacking. Note: Home sick Monday, remained indoors all day.

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations unless noted.

Kitchen (Active Zone):

- glass_hana, glass_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Move to kitchen_table_k1 or sink_k1 during evening use.
- glass_ines: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 during evening use.

- mug_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to dish_rack_k1 or sink_k1.

- shopping_bag_shared: Usually counter_k1. Moves to pantry_shelf_k1 after unpacking.
- dog_food_bag_shared: Usually pantry_shelf_k1. Moves to floor_k_k1 during feeding, back to pantry after.
